span_assumption: REFUTED by the Section of Barn at Bolsterstone (n109), inspected at full resolution in cycle 49: that barn is a CRUCK TRUSS WITH OUTSHUTS, so breadth is NOT the roof span and no single pitch describes the section. Walton's aisling is unstated; if arcaded, the true main span is well under 53 ft and this 24.4 deg is too shallow. DO NOT USE as a measurement.
Addy states the roof is 'in a single span extending across the whole breadth', so the 43 ft span is the author's own, not an assumption.
'17 feet to the square, and 27 feet to the ridge'; square = wall-head. Rectangular keep, roof concealed behind the parapet.
